title: [MVP] ClaWDID service + spec hardening
description: Ship an OSS ClaWDID mapping/audit service to deploy at clawdid.ai. Includes: tighten SOT/addendum specs (canonicalization/test vectors, message_id signing, to_did rotation semantics, did:claw derivation bytes, log hash-chain + terminology), then implement Go service with endpoints POST/GET/PUT /did, per-DID log, auth for /full, SQLite/Postgres storage, and basic tests + docker run.
